_template: Evidence Bundle form (map v3.6 §3.3). Fill order: claims -> criteria-lock commit -> THIS manifest -> run -> verdict. This file does NOT validate until placeholders are replaced. Validate after filling: python3 schemas/intake_validate.py <this-file> <verdict-file>. One schema for both directions: client fills as input package, provider adds roles/hashes. _-prefixed keys are guidance and ignored by the schema.

object._comment: the verified object: repo and the exact commit it is frozen at

criteria_lock._comment: commit where claims were fixed in writing BEFORE results were seen; post-hoc changes must be marked and re-run
criteria_lock.note: FILL-IN: what was locked, where, and that it predates the run

evidence._comment: one item per artifact. File artifact: path + sha256. Publication: url (+date), no sha256. sha256:null is allowed ONLY with a note explaining why (example: results/ is gitignored; regenerate with: <command>). role: vocabulary BLOCKED on owner decision (spec §3.7 client-*/provider-* vs live author-*), see schemas/evidence-manifest.schema.json $comment.
evidence.type: FILL-IN: code | dependencies | summary | run-output | publication
evidence.note: FILL-IN: one line on what this artifact is; mandatory if sha256 is null

controls._comment: negative controls: data with no signal by construction. A reliability claim with status=PASS MUST reference one of these (with N) in verdict.json
controls.description: FILL-IN: what is controlled (example: pure noise, H0 true)

disclosure_levels._comment: one line per level actually used; unused levels stay null
